_help: Manual labels for Videre-sourced formats (used by build_videre.py). One section per format.
rules:  checked in order; the first match wins. By default a rule only touches decks Videre
could only label by colour (WU, UBR, 4c...). Add "override": true to relabel any deck.
all  = every card must be in the 75     any  = at least one of these
none = none of these may be in the 75   deck / group = the labels to use
decks:  relabel one exact decklist by its Videre deck id, e.g. "58714313": "Thundertrap Tempo"
rename: rename a Videre label everywhere, e.g. "Lurrus PO": "Paradoxical Outcome".
After editing, run: python build_videre.py vintage
